records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our asset-based reportable segments, Expedited and Dedicated, contributed approximately 67% of total revenue, 69% of operating income, 63% of total freight revenue, and 72% of adjusted operating income in the quarter.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: While the freight market, consisting of a combination of freight rates and volumes, remained challenging throughout the third quarter we achieved $0.99 per diluted share for the third quarter and are pleased with both our results and the resiliency of our model despite these market headwinds.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The reduction in tractors was an intentional effort by management to adjust the fleet size down in response to the reduced volumes of available freight with expedited service requirements.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our Expedited reportable segment experienced comparable freight revenue with approximately 2% fewer tractors, but experienced diminished margins compared to the third quarter last year.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our asset-light reportable segments contributed approximately 33% of total revenue, 31% of operating income, 37% of total freight revenue, and 28% of adjusted operating income in the quarter.
